mapper.sql: id, user_id, task_id, task_title, planned_minutes, actual_minutes, energy_label, note, completed_time, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sekai_Draw_lots_focus_session (user_id, task_id, task_title, planned_minutes, actual_minutes, energy_label, note, completed_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{taskId}, #{taskTitle}, #{plannedMinutes}, #{actualMinutes}, #{energyLabel}, #{note}, #{completedTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sekai_Draw_lots_focus_session WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(completed_time, '%m-%d') AS label, COUNT(*) AS count, CAST(SUM(actual_minutes) AS SIGNED) AS score FROM sekai_Draw_lots_focus_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND completed_time >= #{since} GROUP BY DATE(completed_time), DATE_FORMAT(completed_time, '%m-%d') ORDER BY DATE(completed_time)
